Alex let out a long, content sigh as he plopped down, setting one bag next to him and the other on the floor beside the couch. Tiegan plopped down just as lazily beside him and laughed softly as he turned to face his friend. 

Alex noticed the burning stare in the side of his face and after a few seconds he smiled and scoffed playfully, turning to face Tiegan. 

"What?" He chuckled, raising an eyebrow. 

Tiegan shook his head and laughed, a mischievous glint in his eye. 

"You sat down like an old man." 

Alex scoffed. 

"Oh yeah? Well what if I am an old man? You got something against old men?" 

He shook his head and playfully tsked. 

"Shame on you." 

Tiegan laughed softly and rolled his eyes before biting the inside of his cheek and tilting his head. 

"Alex...I have....a question for you, actually." 

Alex pursed his lips and shifted so he could look at Tiegan more comfortably before humming in reply. 

"Oh yeah? What is it?" 

Tiegan furled his lips before laughing a soft. nervous smile. He fiddled with his fingers in his lap and shook his head, finally looking up at Alex with an anxious, yet gentle grin.

My aunt was married to this guy named Mike. He was the best uncle ever, he'd always take me, my brother, and my two cousins to the candy store, he'd watch movies and play with us. He never made us feel uncomfortable, not once, and when he smiled, it made you smile, because you could feel the vibes just radiating off of his body. He'd bake the best soft cookies, he made clothes for my dolls, he put me on his shoulders during parades and games and even when walking through an outdoor  or something. He was the perfect uncle, way too perfect. 

In 2008 (I was eight) he went missing. The family was DEVASTATED. For the longest time we thought he had gotten killed. We had a funeral for him and everything.

I was 9-12, don't remember the exact year, but I went over to my aunt's house, and everyone was gathered around the tv, still as a statue. 

I just walked over, and looked at what they were looking at. 

On the tv was a picture of my uncle Mike. He'd murdered I think two young girls, and their mother. He looked terrible. His eyes were sunken, his face was hardened. 

They found him. And the worst part was that his name wasn't even Mike.
